convert_dpt_checkpoint: convert a MiDaS DPT Beit checkpoint to HuggingFace DPT format for depth estimation
get_dpt_config: get DPT configuration parameters based on model name for beit-base-384, beit-large-384, or beit-large-512
create_rename_keys: create key renaming mappings from original MiDaS checkpoint to HuggingFace DPT structure
read_in_q_k_v: split concatenated QKV weight matrices into separate query, key, and value tensors for each encoder layer
remove_ignore_keys_: remove ignored keys like classification head weights and biases from the checkpoint state dict
